about: promote_reasons(row, computed, blend_cap) from backend/worksheets_hplc_promote.py over fixed rows. row is the row facts exactly as GET /worksheets/{id}/hplc serves them; computed is hplc_prep.compute_row(row's declared_mg, form, peptide_id, components; row.hplc_prep; no rules; row.params), or null when the row has a null form or no components and is never computed; reasons is the answer, in order. The two backstop cases take a real compute_row answer with one value set to null by hand (no real input reaches the backstop). Not in this file, because the server decides them outside the rows the sheet serves: the completed worksheet (promote_row), a single peptide that is a catalog blend (decided on the server: promote_row adds the row key peptide_is_blend from the catalog, a key the sheet never serves), and the curve density check (needs the calibration curves). Regenerate: C:/tmp/hplc-build/venv/Scripts/python.exe backend/tests/fixtures/make_hplc_promote_reason_cases.py
